title: Ashbury Rewards Tier Benefits: Relocation Compensation Units for Multi-Night Reservations
content:
For Ashbury Rewards relocation compensation, the number of compensation units of a relocated reservation depends on the tier and on the nights booked on the relocated reservation; the tier's relocation compensation points are paid once for each compensation unit. The nights booked are the nights shown on the reservation's Room Reservations record, from the scheduled arrival date to the scheduled departure date.

## Units by tier and nights booked

| Tier | Nights booked on the relocated reservation | Compensation units |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 2 or more | One unit for each night booked |
| Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 1 | No further units under this table |
| Silver Elite or Gold Elite | 3 or more | 2 units |
| Silver Elite or Gold Elite | 1 or 2 | No further units under this table |
| Ashbury Rewards Member | any | No further units under this table |

In words: a member at Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite whose relocated reservation was booked for two or more nights receives one unit for each night booked; a member at Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite or Gold Elite whose relocated reservation was booked for three or more nights receives two units.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical reservations)

- **Nights booked.** The units follow the nights booked on the relocated reservation.
- **Thresholds.** For the three upper tiers the threshold is 2 nights booked; for Silver Elite and Gold Elite it is 3 nights booked, and the units stay at 2 however long the reservation.

| Tier | Nights booked | Compensation units | Points for the units, tier's figure taken as 15000 for Platinum and 10000 for Gold |
|---|---|---|---|
| Platinum Elite | 4 | 4 | 60000 |
| Gold Elite | 3 | 2 | 20000 |
| Gold Elite | 9 | 2 | 20000 |
